title: FleetStream — Fleet Intelligence
description: The business questions the platform exists to answer, queried straight off the Gold Iceberg tables through Trino. No extract and no copy: this is the same data Spark wrote.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT active_vehicles FROM iceberg.gold.fleet_daily_summary ORDER BY event_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT total_trips FROM iceberg.gold.fleet_daily_summary ORDER BY event_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT total_distance_km FROM iceberg.gold.fleet_daily_summary ORDER BY event_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT fleet_l_per_100km FROM iceberg.gold.fleet_daily_summary ORDER BY event_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT total_incidents FROM iceberg.gold.fleet_daily_summary ORDER BY event_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT avg_utilisation_pct FROM iceberg.gold.fleet_daily_summary ORDER BY event_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(event_date AS timestamp) AS time, total_distance_km, total_fuel_consumed_l FROM iceberg.gold.fleet_daily_summary ORDER BY event_date
SELECT CAST(event_date AS timestamp) AS time, overheat_incidents, overspeed_incidents, low_fuel_incidents FROM iceberg.gold.fleet_daily_summary ORDER BY event_date

panels.title: Vehicle health — which vehicles need maintenance?
Maintenance shortlist
panels.description: Vehicles flagged by a rule an operator can read and check, not by an opaque score.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT vehicle_id, vehicle_description, region, max_engine_temperature_c, overheat_event_count, total_incidents, round(consumption_vs_rated_ratio, 2) AS fuel_vs_rated FROM iceberg.gold.vehicle_performance WHERE needs_maintenance_review ORDER BY overheat_event_count DESC, max_engine_temperature_c DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Overheating incidents yesterday
panels.description: The section 65 business query, answered from the Gold layer.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT vehicle_id, count(*) AS overheating_events FROM iceberg.gold.fact_driver_incident WHERE incident_type IN ('engine_overheat', 'engine_critical_overheat') AND event_date = current_date - interval '1' day GROUP BY vehicle_id ORDER BY overheating_events DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Driver behaviour — normalised per 100 km
panels.description: Rates rather than counts, so a driver who simply drives further is not ranked as worse.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT driver_name, driver_category, risk_band, total_trips, round(total_distance_km, 0) AS distance_km, overspeed_events_per_100km, l_per_100km FROM iceberg.gold.driver_performance WHERE total_trips >= 3 ORDER BY overspeed_events_per_100km DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Route reliability
panels.description: The gap between median and p95 duration is what makes a route unreliable — an average hides it completely.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT route_name, haul_type, total_trips, median_duration_minutes, p95_duration_minutes, duration_spread_minutes, avg_l_per_100km FROM iceberg.gold.route_performance ORDER BY duration_spread_minutes DESC

panels.title: Rejections by rule
panels.description: Which quality rule is firing, and how often relative to accepted volume. 'Quality dropped' is not actionable; 'the fuel_level_range rule is firing on 4% of records' is.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT report_date, rule_name, rule_severity, violation_count, rejected_event_count, accepted_event_count, rejection_rate_pct FROM iceberg.gold.data_quality_summary ORDER BY report_date DESC, violation_count DESC LIMIT 50
